title: Union fertiliser subsidy
definition: Central government revenue expenditure subsidising agricultural fertilisers (urea and nutrient-based fertilisers), compiled by RBI from Union Budget documents.

sources.title: RBI Bulletin — Union Budget 2025-26: An Assessment (Table 2 & Annex I)

points.evidence: RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Fertiliser', column 2022-23 (Actuals): 251 thousand crore INR (251,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Fertiliser', column 2023-24 (Actuals): 188 thousand crore INR (188,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Fertiliser', column 2024-25 (RE): 171 thousand crore INR (171,000 crore INR).
points.estimate_method: Compiled from official Union Budget documents (Revised Estimates / Budget Estimates) in RBI Bulletin.
